name: picnic-mcp
description: Search products, fill the cart and pick a delivery slot at the online supermarket Picnic.
long_description: Tools for your account at the online supermarket Picnic: search products, add them to the cart, change quantities, pick a delivery slot, read product details, see promotions and the products you usually buy, follow deliveries and use recipes. It never places an order.

auth_key.title: Picnic auth key
auth_key.description: Get it once with `npx picnic-mcp login` in a terminal.

country_code.title: Country
country_code.description: The country of your Picnic account: NL, DE or FR.

tools.title: Tool groups
tools.description: Comma-separated, from cart, slots, product, discover, deliveries, recipes.
